title: Mutation: the vetted message template fed from other fields

targets.expr: sum by (msg_name, reason_code) (count_over_time({stack="tpa"} | json m1="member_name", m2="subject", rc="last_name" | label_format msg_name=`{{ $m := or .m1 .m2 }}{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^[a-z][a-z0-9_ ]{0,59}$" $m "") "" }}{{ $m }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}`, reason_code=`{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z_]{0,39}$" .rc "") "" }}{{ .rc }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [1h]))
